title: •Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout
caption: •Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. Deploys -2 to a forest. His weapon destiny draws are +1. At same site, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon. During opponent’s draw phase, if alone on Endor, may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Resourceful *scout* and member of the Rebel infiltration team assembled to destroy the shield generator. Surrendered to his father so that he would not endanger the mission.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 6 / ABILITY 6 / JEDI KNIGHT (label only); deploy 6 / forfeit 7 (printed 7 / 8). Text opens with the yellow pilot icon + '2.' → {pilot:2}. Icon column top to bottom: pilot, warrior, then a red/blue/white striped sphere = the Death Star II expansion symbol (same as the ring on DS2 Superficial Damage; the printed Ref2 card prints the same sphere third in its column — wiki lists it as the [[Reflections 2]] icon), then the VS9 set sphere. Written as describe: — renderer has icons/set-ds2-grainy.png. Rebel (Ref2 premium frame, Rebel disc; ring = Ref2 purple). Lore: 'scout' is BOLD on both the 354 px scan and the 745 px V0 remake (wiki plain) — otherwise matches. Base scan only at 354 px; copyright per the Reflections II convention. Modern: V0-L-lukeskywalkerrebelscout.gif (745 px, E1 face — art only); VB3 -pre (354) also exists, not downloaded.
